Understanding the Riskometer

The Riskometer is a risk-measuring tool used in the mutual fund industry to depict the risk level of a mutual fund scheme.

Risk levels

  • Low Risk: Investments are considered safe, with minimal volatility.
  • Moderate Risk: Investments may experience some fluctuation in value.
  • Very High Risk: Investments are exposed to significant market fluctuation.

Mutual fund returns are not guaranteed and depend on market conditions.

Investors should read the scheme information document before investing.

Generating awareness about risk is part of investor education.
